gloss.en: isti'ara — borrowing: the majaz whose relation is likeness (masdar of اسْتَعَارَ)
gloss.tr: istiâre — ödünç alma: alâkası müşâbehet olan mecaz (اسْتَعَارَ'nin masdarı)

gloss.en: tahqiqiyya — the isti'ara whose meaning is realised (nisba)
fully armed (شَاكِي السِّلَاحِ); a manqus from شَائِك
gloss.tr: tepeden tırnağa silâhlı (شَاكِي السِّلَاحِ); شَائِك'ten mankûs

gloss.en: borrowed (ism maf'ul of اسْتَعَارَ); the borrowed word
the water-carrying camel; then the water-skin
gloss.tr: su taşıyan deve; sonra su tulumu

gloss.en: effect, what is caused (ism maf'ul of سَبَّبَ)
Exalted is He (the formula after the divine name)
what dwells in a place (ism fa'il of حَلَّ)
interpretation — turning a wording from its plain sense (masdar, Form II)
to come to, end up as (آلَ يَؤُولُ; hollow)
to part from, differ from (Form III)
wifaqiyya — the istiʿara whose two ends can meet in one thing
gloss.tr: vifâkıyye — iki tarafı bir şeyde birleşebilen istiâre

gloss.en: ʿinadiyya — the istiʿara whose two ends cannot meet in one thing
gloss.tr: inâdiyye — iki tarafı bir şeyde birleşemeyen istiâre

gloss.en: to be impossible; to refuse (Form VIII)
gloss.tr: mümteni olmak, imkânsız olmak; kaçınmak (VIII. bâb)

gloss.en: the jamiʿ — the feature the two ends share (ism faʿil of جَمَعَ)
gloss.tr: câmi — iki tarafın ortak vasfı (جَمَعَ'nin ism-i fâili)

gloss.en: entering, included in (ism faʿil of دَخَلَ)
what is understood, the concept (ism mafʿul of فَهِمَ)
ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam — the prayer written after the Prophet's name
gloss.tr: sallallâhu aleyhi ve sellem — Peygamber'in adından sonra yazılan dua

gloss.en: a cry of alarm, a call to arms
ʿammiyya — the common istiʿara, whose jamiʿ is plain
gloss.tr: âmmiyye — câmii açık olan, herkesin anladığı istiâre

gloss.en: hackneyed, worn by use (ism mafʿul of اِبْتَذَلَ)
gloss.tr: mübtezel, kullanıla kullanıla eskimiş (اِبْتَذَلَ'nin ism-i mef'ûlü)

gloss.en: khassiyya — the rare istiʿara, grasped by the elite alone
gloss.tr: hâssiyye — yalnız havâssın kavradığı garip istiâre

gloss.en: to sit wrapped, knees drawn up and bound (the ihtibaʾ) (Form VIII, naqis)
gloss.tr: ihtibâ etmek — dizlerini karnına çekip sarınarak oturmak (VIII. bâb, nâkıs)

gloss.en: a wide torrent-bed of sand and pebbles
gloss.tr: ebtah — çakıllı, kumlu geniş sel yatağı

gloss.en: to strip off, flay; to draw (the day) out of (the night)
resting-place, bed; grave (ism makan of رَقَدَ)
gloss.tr: yatılan yer, yatak; kabir (رَقَدَ'nin ism-i mekânı)

gloss.en: to split, cleave; صَدَعَ بِالْأَمْرِ: to declare it openly
to overflow, exceed its bounds (naqis-ya: طَغَى يَطْغَى)
the ship (that runs on the water); a girl
that is, i.e. — the particle of explanation
asliyya — the istiʿara whose borrowed word is a noun of a kind
gloss.tr: asliyye — ödünç lafzı cins ismi olan istiâre

gloss.en: tabaʿiyya — the istiʿara in a verb, a derived noun or a particle, following the likening in the meaning
gloss.tr: tebeiyye — fiilde, müştakta yahut harfte, mânâdaki benzetmeye tâbi istiâre

gloss.en: the masdar — the verbal noun the verb's forms issue from
what a thing hangs on, its object of relation (ism mafʿul of تَعَلَّقَ)
gloss.tr: müteallak — bir şeyin bağlandığı, ilgili olduğu şey (تَعَلَّقَ'nin ism-i mef'ûlü)

gloss.en: the letter lam — here the particle لِ
giving the cause, purpose (the lam of taʿlil)
following upon, resulting from (masdar of تَرَتَّبَ)
gloss.tr: terettüb — bir şeyin ardından gelme (تَرَتَّبَ'nin masdarı)

gloss.en: the faʿil — the doer, the verb's subject
the majrur — the noun after a jarr particle
to entertain a guest, offer hospitality (naqis-ya: قَرَى يَقْرِي)
to cut, slit lengthwise (doubled: قَدَّ يَقُدُّ)
the mulaʾim — what suits one of the istiʿara's two ends (ism faʿil of لَاءَمَ)
gloss.tr: mülâim — istiârenin iki tarafından birine uyan şey (لَاءَمَ'nin ism-i fâili)

gloss.en: mutlaqa — the istiʿara joined to no mulaʾim
mujarrada — the istiʿara joined to what suits the mustaʿar lahu (the tajrid)
gloss.tr: mücerrede — müsteârun lehe uyana bağlanmış istiâre (tecrîd)

gloss.en: murashshaha — the istiʿara joined to what suits the mustaʿar minhu (the tarshih)
gloss.tr: müreşşaha — müsteârun minhe uyana bağlanmış istiâre (terşîh)

gloss.en: branching — building further speech on the istiʿara (masdar of فَرَّعَ)
gloss.tr: tefrî — istiâre üzerine söz kurma (فَرَّعَ'nin masdarı)

gloss.en: to fall forfeit, become a pledge past redeeming (غَلِقَ يَغْلَقُ)
Zuhayr (b. Abi Sulma), the pre-Islamic poet
the tarshih — joining the istiʿara to what suits the mustaʿar minhu (masdar of رَشَّحَ)
gloss.tr: terşîh — istiâreyi müsteârun minhe uyanla bir araya getirme (رَشَّحَ'nin masdarı)

gloss.en: foundation, what a thing is built on
branch — what is built on the root
to spread, become widespread (naqis-waw: فَشَا يَفْشُو)
use — what a speaker does with a wording (masdar, Form X)
they two (the dual alif on the verb)
to hide in the mind, keep unspoken (Form IV)
proper to, peculiar to (ism faʿil of اِخْتَصَّ)
hinted at, kept hidden (ism mafʿul of كَنَى)
gloss.tr: kinâye edilen, gizli tutulan (كَنَى'nın ism-i mef'ûlü)

gloss.en: makniyya — the istiʿara with the bihi hidden and only the mushabbah spoken
gloss.tr: mekniyye — bihi gizli, yalnız müşebbehi söylenen istiâre

gloss.en: takhyiliyya — the affirming, for the mushabbah, of a thing proper to the hidden bihi
gloss.tr: tahyîliyye — gizli bihe has bir şeyin müşebbeh için isbatı

gloss.en: musarraha — Sakkaki's declared istiʿara, the bihi's word spoken
gloss.tr: musarraha — Sekkâkî'nin açık istiâresi, bihin lafzı söylenmiş

gloss.en: tamthiliyya — the compound istiʿara of a picture
the Hudhali — Abu Dhuʾayb, poet of Hudhayl
gloss.tr: Hüzelî — Ebû Züeyb, Hüzeyl kabilesinin şairi

gloss.en: to find (a thing so) (Form IV, naqis; two objects)
snatching away, killing unawares (masdar of اِغْتَالَ)
speaking clearly, eloquent (ism faʿil of أَفْصَحَ)
what a thing stands on, its support
to sober up, come to (naqis-waw: صَحَا يَصْحُو)
riding-camel, a beast fit to ride
as if — the particle of likening among inna's sisters
one crossing, passing (ism faʿil of عَبَرَ)
al-Sakkaki (d. 626/1229), author of the Miftah al-ʿUlum
to answer, refute; to return (doubled: رَدَّ يَرُدُّ)
gloss.tr: cevap vermek, reddetmek; geri çevirmek (muzâaf: رَدَّ يَرُدُّ)
